projects.description: Search your computer by what's in your files: photos, PDFs, documents, recordings, videos and code. On-device on Mac, Windows and Linux, built on Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.
projects.readme_excerpt:
**Mac.** Download the DMG from [Releases](https://github.com/ARahim3/DigUp/releases/latest) and drag DigUp to
Applications, or use Homebrew: `brew install --cask arahim3/tap/digup`. It needs an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 14 or
later.

**Windows.** Download `DigUp_x.y.z_x64-setup.exe` from the
[beta release](https://github.com/ARahim3/DigUp/releases/tag/v0.7.0-beta.2) and run it. It installs for you only, with
no admin rights. Windows may say it doesn't recognize the app, because the installer isn't signed yet: choose More
info, then Run anyway. It needs 64-bit Windows 10 or 11.

**Linux.** On Ubuntu, Debian, Mint and the like, download the .deb and install it:

```sh
sudo apt install ./DigUp_x.y.z_amd64.deb
```

The package is called `dig-up`, because Debian already has an unrelated `digup`. Anywhere else, download the
AppImage, make it executable and run it. Both are for 64-bit Intel and AMD processors and work on Ubuntu 22.04,
Debian 12, Mint 21 and newer.

projects.readme_intro: DigUp Describe it. Dig it up. Search the files on your computer by what's in them, with Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2 . Download for Mac   · Windows (beta)   · Linux (beta) Free and open source. Everything runs on your computer. EmbeddingGemma 2 is the multimodal embedding model Google DeepMind released in October 2026. It puts text, images, audio and video into one shared space: a photo of a dog on a beach lands next to the words "a dog on the beach", and a recording of someone talking about sleep lands next to "where they talk about sleep". It understands more than 100 languages, it's open (Apache 2.0), and at 740M parameters it's small enough to run on a laptop. projects.description: SolidCraft: an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Desktop, web, and automation through MCP.
projects.readme_excerpt:
cargo run --release -p solidcraft -- --sample          # desktop app with a sample part
cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- commands      # the command registry
cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- run examples/bracket.json --out bracket.step
cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- snapshot examples/bracket.json --out bracket.png
cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- render examples/render-studio.json --out product.png
cargo run --release -p solidcraft -- part.step          # open a STEP file as a new design
cargo run --release -p solidcraft-cli -- eval part.step # measure an imported STEP file
cargo xtask ci                                          # fmt, clippy, tests, icons, assets, layers, wasm
projects.readme_intro: SolidCraft An open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Sketch, constrain, and build solids with a parametric feature timeline. Change a dimension and watch your model rebuild. Run it on your desktop, in your browser, or let AI agents model through the built-in MCP server.
